item.title: Flu cases reach epidemic levels as infections continue to rise
item.description: Influenza cases have risen to levels that officially constitute an epidemic. The number of infections first crossed the designated threshold a week ago.

item.title: Dutch authorities help block €1.2 billion in fake money in major Europol operation
item.description: Authorities from 18 countries have worked together in a coordinated police and customs operation to stop approximately €1.2 billion in counterfeit cash from reaching the public.

item.title: Jumbo owners finalize HEMA acquisition, brands to remain separate
item.description: The Van Eerd family’s investment vehicle has finalized its takeover of HEMA.

item.title: Authorities probe past failures in widespread sexual extortion case
item.description: Authorities in eastern Netherlands are reviewing prior reports and complaints of sexual extortion against Borculo resident Mark S.,32, which had gone unaddressed by the police since 2020.

item.title: Poor Amsterdam districts don't benefit from city's shady trees
item.description: The cooling shade of trees is unevenly distributed across cities worldwide, including Amsterdam.

item.title: Dutch gov’t won’t invest extra in women’s health until at least 2030, Minister says
item.description: Caretaker State Secretary for Prevention Judith Tielen does not plan to allocate extra government funding to women’s health before 2030.

item.title: Sharp increase in mortgages; Average €513,000 to buy a home
item.description: In the second half of last year, over 241,000 mortgages were taken out, 14 percent more than a year earlier, the Land Registry reported.

item.title: Number of city councillors receiving threats doubled since last municipal election
item.description: A third of municipal councilors experienced threats, aggression, or verbal abuse during this past term.
